title: Out-of-band transfer inflates the per-share price

root_cause.description: a direct transfer to the vault raises totalAssets without minting shares, so the redemption price of every existing share rises at the depositors' expense
root_cause.mechanism: totalAssets is read from the live token balance, and a plain transfer is never accounted for as a deposit

invariant.statement: the share price must not move in favor of existing shares from out-of-band transfers
